correctness.rationale: The exact square and hexagonal dispersion relations reduce the relevant high-energy edges to scalar analytic equations near each Neumann center. Taylor expansion gives square gap width 8/ell - 8 ell/[3 (m pi)^2] + O(m^-4) and total hexagonal band-pair width 8(sqrt(3)-1)/ell + 8 ell(4-3sqrt(3))/[3 (m pi)^2] + O(m^-4). The m^-2 tails are summable, the number of centers below K is ell sqrt(K)/pi + O(1), and at most one terminal cell is partial, proving the stated O(1) cumulative remainders. The standalone verifier numerically solves the exact edge equations for representative ell and m values.

The result supplies a sharp finite-energy convergence scale, rules out the logarithmic accumulation allowed by the published errors, and produces edge-length-independent coefficients for the contrasting square and hexagonal topologies.
